name: Novel / unexplained outbreaks
summary: No unexplained cluster under international investigation found by 20 Nov
state: UKHSA added its week 46 outbreaks-under-monitoring report, for the week to 15 Nov, on 19 Nov (UKHSA). The level stays Normal.
